assets.name: heti-worlds
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production assets for a dark Chinese Journey to the West action RPG. Painterly realistic 3D game art, intricate ancient Chinese materials, dramatic restrained lighting, no text, no letters, no captions, no UI, no grid lines, no watermark. Landscape 1536x1024 triptych with exactly THREE EQUAL vertical panels, no border, each showing one complete scene. Left: Pingding Twin Furnace Valley, black basalt terraces, two enormous bronze alchemical furnaces with gold and copper fire, charred name tablets, mountain fog. Center: Lotus Cave of Reversed Names, silver lilac lotus-shaped stalactites and inverted hanging bronze tablets above violet water, long crooked stair. Right: Wuji Mirror Well Palace, ruined jade green royal courtyard, deep central mirror well, broken coronation dais, wet jade tiles reflecting a false crown. All high oblique isometric view from above, no characters, walkable foreground courtyards occupy lower half, rich highly detailed environments, coherent sinister visual style.
